## About
We sell used and remanufactured truck parts from Medley, just outside Miami. We carry engines, transmissions, differentials, tandem cutoffs, axles, cabs, hoods and a lot more, from brands like Caterpillar, Cummins, Detroit, Mack, Eaton, Allison, Rockwell, Spicer and Volvo.
Customers know us through Alex, who reviewers describe as honest, helpful and full of knowledge about these trucks. We deliver in Miami, sell nationwide and export worldwide.
We're rated 4.7 on Google from 313 reviews. Stop by Monday through Friday or give us a call.

## Services
- Used engines: Complete engines, inspected and tested running, from brands like Caterpillar, Cummins, Detroit, International and Mack. Many are in stock.
- Used and remanufactured transmissions: Manual transmissions from 5 to 18 speed, plus automatics, from major brands like Eaton, Allison and Mack.
- Tandem cutoffs: Tandem cutoffs, including remanufactured Mack units.
- Used heavy-duty, medium and light truck parts: A big inventory of used parts for trucks of every size, from almost all the major brands.

## FAQ
Q: What brands do you carry?
A: Almost all the major ones, including Caterpillar, Cummins, Detroit, International, Rockwell, Eaton-Fuller, Volvo, Ford, Mack, Isuzu, Mercedes and Spicer.

Q: Do you deliver?
A: Yes, we deliver in Miami. We also sell nationwide and export worldwide.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 7 AM to 5 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
